source_title: OKX will launch JUP/USDT for spot trading

spot_trading_start.statement: OKX announced that JUP/USDT spot trading was scheduled to open at 15:10 UTC on 2024-01-31.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
